description: Use when a user asks about a 401(k) employer match, e.g. "am I getting my full 401(k) match?", "how much is my employer match worth?" or "what percent should I put in to get the full match?". Your yearly 401(k) contribution, the employer match, the percent needed for the full match and any match left unclaimed, using 2026 IRS limits ($24,500 employee, catch-up at 50 and over and at 60 to 63, $72,000 overall, $360,000 pay cap). Supports a two tier formula such as 100% up to 3% then 50% of the next 2%. Optional years and annual_return project the balance.

annual_return.description: Yearly return percent for the projection (default 7).

contribution_percent.description: Percent of pay you contribute, e.g. 4.

match_percent.description: Employer match rate percent, e.g. 50 for 50 cents per dollar (default 50).

match_up_to_percent.description: Percent of pay the match applies to (default 6).

tier2_match_percent.description: Optional second tier match rate percent.

tier2_up_to_percent.description: Optional second tier size, percent of pay.

name: calculate_401k_match
title: 401(k) employer match calculator
